target.source_basis: Earliest committed extraction at 1d767ab; Notion required authentication; no transcript was embedded, linked, or present in repository history.

verdicts.summary: Current adoption was not measured.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with separate learning and use-history answers.

verdicts.summary: Parallel use excluded work across separate projects.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by covering one or several projects and peak concurrency.

verdicts.summary: The claim that slow AI guaranteed quality was not supported by the modal wording and required checks.
Coordinator and long-run facts could be linked by naming the same job.
The token-budget item already requested observable cutoff outcomes.
AI visual use was not identifiable.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with tool, method, decision, check, and result evidence.

verdicts.summary: Visual checks were universal and mis-sourced.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with decision-focused, risk-based checks and honest sources.

verdicts.summary: Every claim appeared to require adversarial review.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by limiting it to important, uncertain, or risky claims.

verdicts.summary: The wording already required a second, new reviewer rather than the original context.
One browser path could imply an issue had been ruled out.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with explicit outcomes and a one-run limit.

verdicts.summary: Vague approval allowed lasting live actions.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with non-production completion, live read-only agents, and named-person ownership.

verdicts.summary: Seven talk notes omitted material ideas.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by restoring the missing ideas from the preserved extraction.

verdicts.summary: Four topic-to-talk mappings claimed unsupported talk coverage.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with honest mappings and team-gap labels.

verdicts.summary: The T08 agenda title had changed silently.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by restoring the preserved title.

verdicts.summary: The long-run wording did not exclude unattended 60–90 minute jobs.
The baseline already had a direct resumability item, so context crowd-out was not established.
The page cited an unavailable transcript.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with an exact source-limit note.

verdicts.summary: Opening formulas taught answers before the check-in.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with topic-neutral academic jokes.

verdicts.summary: Two learning answers overlapped.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with distinct learning states.

verdicts.summary: Later answers could create contradictory event claims.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by locking pre-guidance answers and separating learning from use history.

verdicts.summary: Unsafe or failed use counted as success.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with structured outcomes; only safe reported use counts as working.

verdicts.summary: A stopped safety trial could fit the broad understanding-gained answer, so universal omission was not proved.
One skip state merged missed, role-mismatch, unknown, and private answers.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with distinct states and explicit private counts.

verdicts.summary: A privacy choice could still export old content.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by suppressing private content and clearing it only when privacy is saved.

verdicts.summary: Notes were taught before evidence and could look like event proof.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by collecting facts before guidance and labeling them as since-event facts.

verdicts.summary: Review results forced false closure.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with supported, shown wrong, and still unclear outcomes.

verdicts.summary: Next steps ignored failed use.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with an outcome-aware follow-up order.

verdicts.summary: Stale notes crossed response states.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with one reviewed answer record and conditional evidence modes.

verdicts.summary: An accidental first answer could not be corrected.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with a complete pre-guidance review and final lock.

verdicts.summary: The opening implied every reader heard all talks.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with first-reader wording.

verdicts.summary: The task export dropped the exact changed-answer label.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by exporting each exact visible label.

verdicts.summary: Reports lacked a person and completion date.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with a required name or handle and lock-time date.

verdicts.summary: A partial answer state crashed note input.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with one draft model and no pre-completion report rendering.

verdicts.summary: Confirmation dropped keyboard focus to the document body.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with stable controls and deliberate heading focus.

verdicts.summary: Completed topics hid the answer powering the report.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with a plain pre-guidance review page.

verdicts.summary: The copy action was buried under excessive copy.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2; result copy fell from 1,155 to 213 visible words and task output from 1,365 to 257 words.

verdicts.summary: Stale content could reach the clipboard before a race warning.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by locking answers before export and removing post-guidance edits.

verdicts.summary: The fallback download was automatic but immediately disclosed after clipboard failure.
All skipped answers were misreported as needing no next step.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with a neutral no-automatic-step message and separate unknown/private counts.

verdicts.summary: Core text and edit actions were too small.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with at least 13px core text and 44px controls.

verdicts.summary: The progress map showed only numbers.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with all ten visible topic names.

verdicts.summary: Section and appendix order appeared broken.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with Sections 1–3 followed by Appendix A.

verdicts.summary: New exposure did not prove learning.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with learned, clearer, unclear, and missed states.

verdicts.summary: Current use had no unknown state.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with a not-sure option.

verdicts.summary: Claimed use could omit every useful fact.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by requiring a fact, explicit unknown, or privacy choice for use or trial.

verdicts.summary: Browser safety rules differed across topics.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with one non-production and live-read-only rule.

verdicts.summary: First readers still met avoidable jargon.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with plain-language alternatives.

verdicts.summary: Private denominators mislabeled disclosed answers.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with disclosed-and-judged labels and private counts.

verdicts.summary: Role relevance could contradict current use.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by keeping role relevance only on the use axis.

verdicts.summary: Current use did not say when it started.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with post-event, pre-event, trial, stopped, unknown, role, and private states.

verdicts.summary: Ongoing use had no structured outcome.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with safe, unsure, problems, and private outcomes.

verdicts.summary: Known-but-unused and one-off trials got no follow-up.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with a complete follow-up order.

verdicts.summary: Touching the privacy option erased an unsaved draft.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by retaining the draft until privacy is saved.

verdicts.summary: The exported frequency changed the visible selection.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with identical visible and exported labels.

verdicts.summary: Completion date used page-load time.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 by setting the date at final lock.

verdicts.summary: A safe-account phrase left a live-action loophole.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with live read-only agents and named-person ownership of lasting actions.

verdicts.summary: Unknown use vanished from the denominator.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with clear-use labels and a separate unknown-use count.

verdicts.summary: Review headings skipped a level.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2; the four-stage axe sweep reports zero violations.

verdicts.summary: The browser requested a missing favicon.
verdicts.resolution: Fixed in b1c02d2 with an inline empty favicon.
